provenance.source_type: python (stored Aspen cracker activities + literature-calibrated turbine inputs)
provenance.inputs_summary: Ahmad 2025 Chemkin ppmv via amcrax.environmental.lca.n2o_noX_per_MWh; Carbon Pricing Act First Schedule GWP

direct_NH3.source: Ahmad 2025 Chemkin reactor network (simulated): N2O 0.15 ppmv (vaporised NH3), NO 83.8-116 ppmv; the paper says Chemkin underestimates NO and cites AIST tests at 282 and 337 ppmv; exhaust-basis conversion is an AmCraX assumption
direct_NH3.gwp_note: Singapore carbon tax: GWP 265 (Carbon Pricing Act 2018, First Schedule). Life-cycle intensity: AR6 273 (lca.py). Both reported; the tax is negligible either way.

blends_and_cracked_gas.N2O: No source gives N2O for NH3-H2 blends or for cracked gas. pathway_table_power.csv scales the direct-NH3 N2O by the NH3 energy share of the fuel: this is an AmCraX assumption, not a sourced value.
blends_and_cracked_gas.NOx: No turbine NOx measurement or simulation for NH3-H2 blends or H2/N2 cracked gas was found (NO_kg_per_MWh = 'not quantified'). GE Vernova (vendor): NOx up to +35 % at 50 vol% H2 in natural gas, possibly double near 100 % H2; NETL 2023: N2-diluted H2 has higher NOx potential than steam-diluted. Qualitative only; not used in costs.
blends_and_cracked_gas.blend_limits: The essay's '30-60 vol% H2 for the H-25 in NH3-H2 blends' is printed in Halim et al. 2025 p. 3 (full text read 24 Nov 2026), relayed from a trade-press article: a vendor-claim grade statement, not tested in that paper. NETL 2022 states 30-60 % hydrogen for Baker Hughes turbines on hydrogen in natural gas (a different fuel); Ahmad 2025 p. 2 gives about 30 vol% for unmodified natural-gas combustors. No measured or simulated H2 limit for NH3-H2 blends exists in the library; the vol% labels in the tables are flags only.
blends_and_cracked_gas.partial_cracking_efficiency: Only Ahmad's two end points are sourced (alpha = 1 and 0). Intermediate efficiencies are a linear interpolation (assumption). Ahmad reports LCOE non-monotonic in the cracked fraction (not reproduced, Supplementary Material not available).

SCR.source: Abuzayed et al. 2025 (EPRG2520) citing their ref. 109 (secondary quote, price year not stated)
SCR.use_here: capital sensitivity only (sensitivity_capital.csv); which pathway needs the advanced SCR is not sourced; SCR reagent (NH3) demand not quantified in any source read; whether Ahmad's Case 2a TCI already includes SCR is not stated in the project note
